ex.en: The hotel staff were very accommodating.
ex.zh: 飯店員工都很樂意配合。

ex.en: Thank you for being so accommodating with our schedule.
ex.zh: 謝謝你這麼配合我們的時程。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看見一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: He had the impudence to cut across our garden.
ex.zh: 他竟然厚著臉皮穿過我們的花園。

ex.en: The pharmacy is across the street.
I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從來沒碰到過這麼倔的人。

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近巧遇一位老朋友。
